svg.title: Offline progress alignment: shared temporal tokens, DTW and correspondence filtering
svg.desc: Offline human-robot progress alignment. The package reads cached per-frame sets of 512-D interaction tokens, not raw pixels. Shared f_theta produces unit-norm 128-D embeddings. Endpoint-constrained DTW runs in both directions, followed by cosine, cycle-return, and distant-margin filtering. Output pairs are heuristic pseudo-correspondences, not verified semantic labels. Scenes and matrix are schematic.

g.text: (d) Adapter detail: token pooling and causal temporal context
